about: Cue as the intern running the projector (Tyler, 2026-11-13, #10): nobody asks it anything, but things come up that the room would want on screen. A wondered-aloud question, a guessed number, options with prices, and a timeline laid out in words should go up unasked; the reactions in between should not.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: So the pitch deck says we're targeting Europe first.

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.text: Right. I wonder what the population of Europe even is.

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: For hosting we got three quotes. AWS is twelve thousand a month, GCP came in at nine, and Azure is ten but with fifty thousand in credits.

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.text: GCP is cheapest but our team knows AWS best.

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.text: Timeline wise, code freeze is November fifteenth, beta goes out the twentieth, the marketing push starts the twenty fifth, and we launch December first.

lines.speaker: Luis
lines.text: Honestly I've never understood how VAT works across EU countries, that's going to bite us on pricing.
